en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Sa’dan who said,

‘I was with Abu Baseer in the bathhouse, so I saw Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> waxing his<sup>asws</sup> armpits, so I informed Abu Baseer of that, so he said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! Which is preferable, plucking the armpit or shaving it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup>said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! Plucking the armpit frails or weakens (the shoulders). Shave it’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu as from Muhammad ibn Ali from Sa‘dan who has said the following: “

I once was with abu Basir in a bathhouse and I saw abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, applying lime on his underarms. I informed abu Basir about it who asked saying, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, which is better; pulling out or shaving the hairs of the underarms?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘O abu Muhammad pulling out the hairs of the underarms weakens (the shoulders) so you must shave them.’”
